## Turn off Gemini Code Assist



This document explains how to turn off Gemini Code Assist.

## Before you begin

* To update a Gemini subscription, make sure you have the
  `billing.subscriptions.update` Identity and Access Management permission. The
  `billing.subscriptions.update` permission is included in the
  [`roles/billing.admin`](https://cloud.google.com/billing/docs/how-to/billing-access#billing.admin)
  IAM role, or you can add the permission to a custom role.

To turn off Gemini Code Assist, do the following:

1. In the Google API Console, go to the **Admin for Gemini** page.

   [Go to Admin for Gemini](https://console.cloud.google.com/gemini-admin)
2. Click **Purchased products**.
3. Select the applicable billing account, and then click **Continue to Admin for
   Gemini page**.
4. From the list of purchased products, select the
   Gemini Code Assist subscription. The name of the subscription
   depends on the name given when Gemini Code Assist was set up.
5. Review the subscription details and check whether **Auto renew** is set to
   **On** or **Off**.

   * If automatic renewal is off, then your Gemini Code Assist
     subscription is set to end on the subscription end date.
   * If automatic renewal is on, then click **Manage subscription** and
     proceed to the next step.
6. For **Automatic subscription renewal**, select **No, don't automatically
   renew**, and then click **Continue**.
7. If you agree to the terms of purchase, select **I agree to the terms of
   this purchase**, and then click **Save changes**.
